method: User listening feedback, followed by Argon native audio review through agy.

findings.hull-slap-02: User liked impact but rejected extra tail noise. Trim to 0.88 seconds with 0.15 second fade; Argon accepted edited result.
findings.wind-steady-03: Argon: usable unpitched low wind bed, but muffled.
findings.wind-strong-03: Argon rejected pitched howling and abrupt tail.
findings.hull-slam-03: Argon rejected separate events and brittle cracking.
findings.wind-steady-04: Argon rejected water sloshing and squeaks.
findings.wind-strong-04: Argon rejected thunder and rain-like tail.
findings.hull-slam-04: Argon rejected brittle smash and separated pre-thump.
findings.wind-steady-05: Argon KEEP: clean natural turbulence, slightly dark tonal balance. Selected for user review.
findings.wind-strong-05: Argon REJECT: percussive flapping, splattering and microphone buffeting.
findings.hull-slam-05: Argon REJECT: isolated sub-bass thump, no recognizable water or wooden hull character.
findings.wind-strong-06: Argon EDIT: stronger wind than reference, early flutter at about 2.1-3.7 seconds; suggested retaining 4-16 seconds with loop crossfade and gentle EQ.
findings.hull-slam-06: Argon REJECT: recognizable water but multiple hits and brittle wood clatter; not salvageable as one heavy impact.
findings.wind-strong-06-edited: Argon KEEP after direct listening to two 11.6-second repetitions: natural unpitched gusts, no intrusive artifacts, clean loop boundary. Selected for user review; original untouched.
findings.thunder-distant-01: Argon KEEP: isolated distant atmospheric roll, clean decay.
findings.thunder-near-01: Argon KEEP: isolated sharp nearby crack and rolling decay, distinct from distant roll.
findings.rain-light-01: Argon KEEP: natural wet irregular patter; recommends a short loop crossfade.
findings.rain-heavy-01: Argon REJECT: intrusive human voices and cheering.
findings.snow-contact-01: Argon REJECT: rhythmic crunchy footsteps instead of soft contact.
findings.sleet-deck-01: Argon KEEP: fine irregular ice-pellet ticking on wood; recommends a short loop crossfade.
findings.hail-deck-01: Argon REJECT: base hail is plausible but includes explosive crash and hammering bursts.
findings.rain-heavy-02: Argon REJECT: water sloshing/churning rather than overhead rainfall.
findings.snow-contact-02: Argon REJECT: periodic coarse brush strokes or footsteps. Prefer existing wind with no added snow-contact layer.
findings.hail-deck-02: Argon KEEP: natural continuous heavier pellet impacts and bounces, distinct from sleet.
findings.rain-light-01-edited: Argon KEEP across two 13.7-second cycles; clean 0.3-second blended boundary.
findings.sleet-deck-01-edited: Argon KEEP across two 11.7-second cycles; clean 0.3-second blended boundary.
findings.rain-heavy-03-edited: Argon KEEP after listening to two 13.7-second cycles: natural dense rainfall, perceptibly heavier than light rain, no foreign artifacts, clean loop boundary.
findings.hail-deck-02-edited: Argon KEEP after listening to two 11.7-second cycles: natural ice-pellet taps and bounces on oak, clean loop boundary.
findings.gull-near-01: Argon EDIT/borderline REJECT: isolated but too busy and mechanically repetitive; initial solitary cry may be salvageable.
findings.seabirds-distant-01: Argon REJECT: dense colony chorus with surf/wind bed instead of sparse isolated calls.
findings.tern-calls-01: Argon REJECT: coarse caw followed by mismatched woodland-like peeps and background twittering.
findings.gull-near-01-edited: Argon KEEP: isolated 1.25-second gull cry with intact ending. Selected from take 01 with a 0.1-second tail fade.
findings.gull-near-02: Argon EDIT/REJECT full phrase: repetitive introductory peeps and later pinched squawks; not selected.
findings.seabirds-distant-02: Argon REJECT: piercing reverberant call over continuous wind/hiss instead of sparse clean distant birds.
findings.tern-calls-02: Argon REJECT: breathy shushing and guttural scrape sounds, not convincing birds.

caution: These are listening judgments, not objective quality metrics. Argon misidentified the source of the edited light impact in its comparison prose; source mapping and timings are taken from local records. The nature-02 report also incorrectly attributed gull-isolated-cry.wav to take 02; it was rendered from gull-near take 01. Its KEEP verdict applies to that named audition file; source identity comes from local generation records and edit settings.

designDecisions.snow: Reuse the existing wind layer with no dedicated precipitation sound. Both optional powder/canvas-contact candidates failed; do not invent noisy snowfall.
